blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than the momentum they built from their breakthrough win, Jean Asis urges the Galeries Tower HighRisers to keep carrying their trust and confidence in each other in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Asis helped Galeries hold on after blowing a two-set lead, as she delivered in the clutch and finished with 14 points to edge Akari, 25-22, 26-24, 23-25, 15-25, 15-10, on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The No. 2 overall pick of last year’s Rookie Draft hopes that this is the start of something good for the HighRisers after their previous struggles. “It’s a big […]...
